coach-carousel-workaround.author: Pirate
coach-carousel-workaround.content:
As of right this second, the API doesn’t fire that a coach changed jobs or even that other teams have interest in them, until the bowl section ends (see photo)

For example, I just synced to w2 bowl week after submitting interest in Stanford. They hired me, but as of now, the API still won’t send that info out 

Here’s the workaround, we tell people to tell us whenever they accept a new job and we run this command 

/carousel coach:Pirate_flag school:Stanford
(change discord name and school)

The discord bot breaks the news, and then the site updates at the next push, and all the fallout stuff like the Temperature page updates (fans happy or angry about the news)
